measurement_limits: One campaign checkpoint path was examined; recurrence across sessions is not established.
The prior readback does not measure agent time, tool calls, or burden caused by reconstructing the missing status.
Rejected checkpoint attempts do not update campaign state and are outside this persisted summary.

outcome.interpretation: The selected-checkout guard could reject malformed evidence, but an accepted checkpoint did not preserve whether a candidate record had been validated or skipped.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment campaign-state and environmental-capability projection

pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Persist a bounded result for each accepted campaign checkpoint and expose its validation status and limits through campaign-state and ECI reads.
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The pre-publication contract check returned no outcome for campaign-state persistence, and the subsequent campaign-state readback had no field distinguishing a validated check from an unselected-checkout skip.
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment campaign checkpoint and ECI projection
pressure_hypothesis.title: Accepted campaign checkpoint did not expose its observation preflight result

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
